snippet.title: Amonimus VS Antz: Panic in the Anthill! (Full Game)
snippet.description:
== Comment ==
Funny story: because it's an emultated old Windows game, like Crazy Taxi, it can only run at either 5 FPS or 500 FPS. So I took the third option, recorded the game and the sound separately, and hoped for editing magic. Worst decision of my life, so the sound remains only for the first (manually added) and last (left as recorded) levels.
For the game itself, it's just Bomberman with 50 levels. It's surprizingly difficult, but when you get used to it there are no new gimmicks or enemies present.
== Information ==
Antz: Panic in the Anthill! is a typical "Bomberman/Dynablaster" style game for one or two players. The player objective in each one of the 50 levels, assuming the role of the valorous ant Z, is to destroy all the rocks, placing bombs (explosive mushrooms in this case) in the game area, avoiding the attack of all the enemy ants. Once all the rocks will be destroyed an exit to the next level will appear in the screen.
== Copyrights ==
Antz: Panic in the Anthill! is developed and published by Light & Shadow Production for PC in 2001.
Antz is a creation and property of DreamWorks Animation 1998.
